head: codex/recovery-admission-20261012
title: fix: share recovery API budgets and repair original terminal debt
body:
## Scope

Reduce GitHub API amplification in the three registered recovery admission workflows and safely reconcile a terminal-null original reservation. This PR remains Draft and grants no landing, approval, merge, or deployment authority.

## Changes

- Read only the exact triggering workflow run, attempt, and jobs; skipped observers stop before downstream work.
- Coordinate the three registered callers through one required DynamoDB compare-and-swap budget with bounded GETs, concurrency, response/time limits, Retry-After and reset-aware 403/429 deferral, and no blind retry after ambiguous writes. Permission failures remain nonapproval evidence.
- Add a read-only checkpoint consumer that checks the producer run tuple, artifact digest/bytes, a bounded GET route grammar, and the resume time. Unit tests exercise a checkpoint produced by the rate-aware reader. No natural artifact handoff currently invokes this consumer.
- Preserve the original PR #2655 reservation identity while superseding an expired repair request. The successor requires three fresh role signatures; the finalizer claim and terminal CAS bind the request/evidence digests, owner run, monotonic revision, lease, terminal/ACK absence, and original merge SHA. The repair receipt remains debt-only and cannot populate the normal original terminal or grant authority.
- Revalidate the repair quorum and immutable ACK on resume. FINALIZER performs physical S3 readback; other roles do not claim physical verification. The whole-platform collector keeps repair debt separate from normal landing closure and natural CORE4 proof.
- Bundle the writer capsule and retain the existing AI-020 Owner boundary.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 43 Python ledger and supersession tests; 8 focused Node test files for admission, 403/rate-aware reads, shared-budget boundaries, checkpoint consumption, and terminal repair; syntax/whitespace checks; deterministic writer-bundle validation. The staging deployer and AWS boundary Node tests did not finish in this sandbox and are not counted as passing. Exact-head GitHub CI remains to be rerun.

## Remaining evidence and limits

- Shared-budget coverage is limited to the three registered admission workflows. Other workflows and direct GitHub API callers remain outside this budget.
- No natural cross-runner execution has demonstrated the shared budget, and no natural run has demonstrated the original scheduled reservation through physical immutable receipt readback.
- The checkpoint consumer is tested but not connected to a workflow artifact handoff. Source remains unmerged and undeployed; the mission remains unresolved until these natural-run and immutable-terminal proofs exist.

Production, Public, G5, provider activation, Ready, approval, dispatch, merge, and deployment remain HOLD/outside this Draft's authority.
